config.ground_truth_methodology: Independent domain-category relevance labels mapped from the 24 EduSuggest taxonomy categories prior to evaluation; already-enrolled courses are excluded from each persona's eligible candidate pool.
limitations: 8 Official Personas with simulated learning histories (3-4 enrollments each) represent structured domain archetypes rather than real production student clickstreams.
Category-level relevance labels evaluate domain alignment rather than fine-grained user satisfaction or completion rate.
Results should be presented in thesis defense as offline simulation evaluation on Official Dataset V2, NOT as a live human user survey.
